experimental_unit: one stimulus word x one prompt condition x one simulated participant

prompt_text_by_variant.first_to_mind:
Generate a broad set of semantic features for the single stimulus word supplied by the user.

Begin with properties that come readily to mind, but do not imitate a hesitant participant or stop merely because the most obvious facts have been listed. Include up to 10 distinct, generally valid properties that help characterize the concept. Features may concern appearance, parts, material, behavior, function, category, location, relations, or ordinary background knowledge.

Favor recall: include a valid property even when it is not diagnostic or would not be among the first few facts most people mention. Exclude accidental details of one unusual instance, subjective opinions, and restatements of the word.

Return only one JSON object with exactly this structure:
{
  "target_word": "the supplied stimulus word",
  "features": [
    "one brief feature proposition",
    "another brief feature proposition"
  ]
}

Return at most 10 different features, one proposition per entry. Include no explanations, numbering, headings, markdown, or text outside the JSON object.
prompt_text_by_variant.perceptual_structural:
Discover perceptual and structural features of the single concept supplied by the user.

Search broadly across shape, color, size, weight, material, surface, texture, temperature, smell, taste, sound, visible parts, internal parts, and how the concept changes over time. Supply up to 10 distinct properties that are generally true of the concept. Less obvious but valid properties are welcome; a property need not be distinctive or commonly volunteered.

Do not include functions, social associations, evaluative opinions, rare trivia, or accidental details of one unusual instance. Do not infer that every listed perceptual dimension must apply; list only defensible propositions.

Return only one JSON object with exactly this structure:
{
  "target_word": "the supplied stimulus word",
  "features": [
    "one brief perceptual or structural proposition",
    "another brief perceptual or structural proposition"
  ]
}

Return at most 10 different features, one proposition per entry. Include no explanations, numbering, headings, markdown, or text outside the JSON object.
prompt_text_by_variant.functional_affordance:
Discover functional and affordance features of the single concept supplied by the user.

Search broadly for what it does, what people or other agents do with it, what actions it permits, what goals it serves, how it is manipulated, what effects it produces, and what can happen to it. Supply up to 10 distinct, generally valid propositions. Include useful secondary functions and ordinary affordances even when they are not defining or immediately obvious.

Do not invent uses that are merely physically possible, describe one unusual event, or repeat the same function in different words. Keep agent and direction roles clear.

Return only one JSON object with exactly this structure:
{
  "target_word": "the supplied stimulus word",
  "features": [
    "one brief functional or affordance proposition",
    "another brief functional or affordance proposition"
  ]
}

Return at most 10 different features, one proposition per entry. Include no explanations, numbering, headings, markdown, or text outside the JSON object.
prompt_text_by_variant.taxonomic_definitional:
Discover taxonomic and definitional features of the single concept supplied by the user.

Search broadly for what kind of thing it is, broader categories it belongs to, important subtypes, contrast classes, constituent type, and properties that are necessary or strongly characteristic of the concept. Supply up to 10 distinct, generally valid propositions. Include multiple informative levels of classification when each adds real information.

Do not merely repeat the stimulus word, list examples as if they were properties, collapse "is a kind of" with "has a part," or state uncertain folk classifications as facts.

Return only one JSON object with exactly this structure:
{
  "target_word": "the supplied stimulus word",
  "features": [
    "one brief taxonomic or definitional proposition",
    "another brief taxonomic or definitional proposition"
  ]
}

Return at most 10 different features, one proposition per entry. Include no explanations, numbering, headings, markdown, or text outside the JSON object.
prompt_text_by_variant.situational_relational:
Discover situational and relational features of the single concept supplied by the user.

Search broadly for where it is found or used, who or what interacts with it, what it commonly accompanies, its social roles, typical events involving it, and thematic or ecological relations. Supply up to 10 distinct, generally valid propositions. Include reliable relations that are informative even when they are not intrinsic physical properties.

Do not use an arbitrary association, a one-off scenario, or a relation that reverses the relevant agent, patient, part, or location role. Each entry must still be a proposition about the target concept.

Return only one JSON object with exactly this structure:
{
  "target_word": "the supplied stimulus word",
  "features": [
    "one brief situational or relational proposition",
    "another brief situational or relational proposition"
  ]
}

Return at most 10 different features, one proposition per entry. Include no explanations, numbering, headings, markdown, or text outside the JSON object.
prompt_text_by_variant.encyclopedic_causal:
Discover encyclopedic and causal features of the single concept supplied by the user.

Search broadly for origins, development, production, mechanisms, causes, consequences, life cycle, historical or scientific facts, and stable background knowledge. Supply up to 10 distinct propositions that are generally valid and useful for characterizing the concept. Include well-established facts even when an ordinary participant might not mention them immediately.

Do not include disputed claims, highly specialized trivia, exact numerical facts that vary by instance, or consequences that are only remotely possible.

Return only one JSON object with exactly this structure:
{
  "target_word": "the supplied stimulus word",
  "features": [
    "one brief encyclopedic or causal proposition",
    "another brief encyclopedic or causal proposition"
  ]
}

Return at most 10 different features, one proposition per entry. Include no explanations, numbering, headings, markdown, or text outside the JSON object.
prompt_text_by_variant.less_obvious_general:
Search for valid but less-obvious semantic features of the single concept supplied by the user.

Imagine that obvious appearance, category, and primary-use facts have already been collected. Find additional generally applicable properties that another careful person could recognize: secondary parts or materials, less salient affordances, stable contexts, characteristic behavior, constraints, causes, or consequences. Favor breadth and recall, and supply up to 10 distinct propositions.

Do not become creative for its own sake. Exclude rare trivia, puns, personal memories, metaphorical descriptions, accidental details, and properties that are merely possible rather than characteristic. Do not refer to an unseen earlier list.

Return only one JSON object with exactly this structure:
{
  "target_word": "the supplied stimulus word",
  "features": [
    "one brief less-obvious but general proposition",
    "another brief less-obvious but general proposition"
  ]
}

Return at most 10 different features, one proposition per entry. Include no explanations, numbering, headings, markdown, or text outside the JSON object.
